newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Elders buys 17 pct of Primac.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Elders buys 17 pct of Primac.

text.p: Pastoral house Elders Australia Ltd had acquired a 17 percent stake in rural services group Primac Holdings Ltd, Elders chairman Alan Newman told the annual meeting on Thursday.
"The shareholding is an insurance policy, it also may present long-term opportunities depending on what Primac want to do...," Newman later told Reuters.
Primac is subject to a hostile takeover bid by IAMA Ltd.
Melbourne-based IAMA is offering nine of its shares for every 10 Primac shares and has had to modify its offer documents following a challenge in the Queensland Supreme Court.
Primac and Elders said on November 1 they had formed a joint venture to manage their Queensland wool and livestock operations.
Primac said the joint venture followed nine months of negotiations and detailed financial analysis which had identified rationalisation benefits of A$4.1 million annually.
Elders has also agreed to a takeover bid by Futuris Corp Ltd.
